decisions: CoverageSession wraps T023 equity ExchangeSession bounds and represents crypto UTC days as [00:00, 24:00) UTC windows; an explicit timezone-aware as_of marks only the currently open session partial.
CoverageState keeps missing, empty, partial, complete, and error distinct. Empty is terminal, complete is satisfied, and partial or error entries are actionable.

A currently open session is classified as partial even when its catalog row is complete, allowing the deterministic partition to be replaced as the session progresses; persisted partial rows are marked replace_existing.
calculate_coverage reads T024 CatalogRepository rows for the requested asset and date range, while plan_gaps returns only missing, partial, and error entries without Azure or provider coupling.
Symbols and data types are canonicalized and sorted before expansion; entries are emitted in stable data-type, symbol, and ascending session-date order for repeatable plans.
Equity planning uses XNYS sessions and excludes weekends and holidays while preserving half-day close bounds; crypto planning uses every inclusive UTC calendar day.

The API is exposed from src/lake/coverage.py through sessions_for, equity_sessions, crypto_sessions, calculate_coverage, plan_gaps, CoverageSession, SessionCoverage, CoverageReport, GapPlan, and CoverageState.
limitations: Tests use the in-memory T024 catalog repository and deterministic historical as_of values; no live Azure, blob, or market-provider calls were made.
Repository-wide pytest emits the pre-existing FastAPI/httpx StarletteDeprecationWarning; all 105 tests pass.
